lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular distribution of high-luminance circular pixel clusters. Blobs are organized into vertical columns with increasing centroid density and decreasing diameter observed towards the anterior (left) portion of the frame.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance values intersecting the centroid columns to form a visible grid-like pattern across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges characterized by a sharp luminance gradient (high-intensity upper edge, low-intensity lower shadow) extending across the upper lateral flank.
